scope: Final-primary ST/SB native batch, independently frozen before reading root decisions; includes radical counterparts X03/X04.

attempts.inspection: Actual complete native image, view_image detail original
observations: Sera lowers her one bronze spearhead into visible fire; two grips, concentrated face and burned cape continue.
Ilvan bends back with distressed expression; left/right arena identities and shield remain readable.
limitations_and_failures: The fire forms a branching junction toward Ilvan rather than a continuous U-turn at the rightmost spearhead. One arm runs down to the spear, another leaves upward and exits frame. No separated outgoing path can be traced from spear to casting forearm.
Ilvan may be recoiling, but the bright point remains at his open casting palm; returned force into forearm is not specifically established.
Burned cape area appears displaced/enlarged relative to preceding view; view/fabric motion limits exact comparison.
attempts.verdict: Forceful acting and actual spear/fire contact, but intended return mechanics fail. Surface finish is not a remedy for path topology.

attempts.inspection: Actual complete native image, view_image detail original
observations: Fire is absent. Ilvan kneels and protects his upper arm/shoulder while Sera stands alert with single spear and persistent ragged cape damage.
Recognizable faces, clothing, shield and arena landmarks continue; quiet aftermath gives useful rhythm contrast.
limitations_and_failures: The foreground scorch contains dense granular debris, orange edge speckles and small floor texture rather than one broad burn.
Ilvan hand touches upper chest/shoulder; precise injured casting-forearm position is partially obscured.
This emotional aftermath does not resolve missing return-path evidence in SB03.
attempts.verdict: High-value source-only finishing target: consolidate scorch and floor, retain burn location and cape damage. Preserve distinct faces and warm drawing.

attempts.inspection: Actual complete native image, view_image detail original
observations: Breathless laughing Tavi and seated Bellguard read as a earned pause with continuing personality.
Orange forearm ring is gone, hammer shaft is continuous and face remains damaged. Separate hands and seated/kneeling adult bodies are broadly coherent.
limitations_and_failures: Dense dusty/scuffed marks cover armor, boots, trousers, skin and floor. The foreground ground is substantially busier than early setup.
Hammer face now carries all-over scraped wear rather than the specific earlier missing chip; damage persists in general but exact chip continuity is not preserved.
attempts.verdict: Strong character aftermath; high-value surface-only finishing. Keep expression, hands, seated weight and recognizable hammer damage.

attempts.inspection: Actual complete native image, view_image detail original
observations: Extreme near boot and enlarged open gauntlet make the scale and attack pressure more immediate.
Tavi remains recognizable, holds one turquoise shaft with two hands and shows effort; a broad orange hook creates readable large directional energy.
limitations_and_failures: Hammer HEAD, not shaft, meets the side/back of the armored lower leg. The requested shaft-behind-right-knee relationship is not shown.
Marked outstretched arm again reads as anatomical right, continuing ST03 side failure rather than restoring ST02 continuity.
Enormous foreground leg occludes the precise joint and support relationship; dramatic foreshortening increases excitement but reduces proof of knee collapse.
Granular foreground floor, repeated dust clumps and dense armor facets add noise.
attempts.verdict: Useful radical scale/view study, not a mechanically equivalent knee sweep. Source-only finishing can quiet ground/armor/dust while preserving the near-boot experiment.

attempts.inspection: Actual complete native image, view_image detail original
observations: Very large orange arc and smaller recognizable fighters establish a larger power scale; blue negative space keeps the main graphic readable.
Distinct upper and lower flame lanes are visually separated for most of their length.
limitations_and_failures: Lower incoming lane ends at Sera lower leg/ground while upper lane touches the raised spearhead. There is a large unconnected gap between those endpoints: no single rightmost spearhead turn links them.
The upper return and lower cast both converge at Ilvan palm; exact returned forearm contact is not differentiated.
Architecture retains more repeated details than a minimal silhouette test, though it remains subordinate.
attempts.verdict: Scale/hierarchy experiment succeeds more than source-contact-target mechanics. Explicitly retain disconnected-turn limitation; texture finishing cannot correct it.

cross_frame_summary: Aftermath beats add expressive consequence and rhythm. The decisive ST knee mechanism and SB redirected pulse topology remain unresolved; broad excitement cannot establish missing contact chains.
phone_scope: No new full-24 phone captures inspected in this batch.
taste_limit: Observations do not constitute owner preferences or canon selection.
